title: Lucky Spin
text: The stars of Dogzy Town shine on you. Spin the outer wheel again and move forward.

title: Golden Paw Bonus
text: The Dogzy Bank pays a loyalty bonus. Collect 200 tokens.

title: Double Trouble
text: Your next token reward is doubled. Twice the shine, twice the swagger.

title: Triple Jackpot
text: Big night in Dogzy Town! Your next token reward is multiplied by 3.

title: Royal Shield
text: Raise the golden shield. It blocks the next raid or attack on your village.

title: Surprise Raid
text: Raid another player's village. Spin the second wheel to see how many tokens you steal.

title: Pickpocket Pup
text: Quick paws! Steal 100 tokens from the player of your choice. A shield blocks it.

title: City Tour
text: Spin the second wheel. Visit that many buildings and complete their tasks.

title: Call from the Bank
text: Move directly to the Bank and collect 100 tokens in interest.

title: Emergency Room
text: Too much adventure! Go to the Hospital and lose your next turn.

title: Parking Ticket
text: You parked your limo on a fire lane. Pay 50 tokens to the Police Station.

title: Lost in Dogzy Town
text: Wrong turn at the Marina. Move back 3 spaces.

title: Shopping Spree
text: The boutiques love you. Pick one free accessory from any shop.

title: The Pyromaniac Strikes
text: The Pyromaniac set fire to your stuff! Lose one accessory unless you have a shield.

title: Level Up!
text: Your hard work pays off. Move up to the next level of Dogzy Town.

title: Treasure Hunt
text: Go to the nearest Search space and play a hidden-object card. Find them all to win an accessory.
